personal.descriptiontop: In my free time I like to play games in all kinds of genres such as action, adventure, simulation and RPG. Beside gaming I also like to read books where I prefer to read books in English and in different genres such as fantasy and adventure.
personal.descriptionbottom: I have come to love watching anime and reading manga and because of tis I started to learn the Japanese language. I am learning it in my spare time and recently started an evening Japanese course organized by the Volksuniversiteit in Eindhoven.

nocore.description: At Nocore, I worked on their payroll platform, which was written in ASP.NET with an MSSQL database. I added new functionality and fixed bugs. I also provided second-line support to resolve customer issues.

anycoin.description: At Anycoin Direct, I added new features and fixed bugs. I worked with C#/.NET and Angular, among other tools. I also learned about Event Sourcing and CQRS.

ycn.description: At Young Capital Next I followed various training courses and obtained various certificates.

whyellow.description: During this internship, I researched the possibilities and limitations of location-based augmented reality (AR) using ARCore in an Android app. I added an example to an Android app to show the possibilities. For the Android app, I worked with Kotlin, and to manage the project effectively, I used Scrum, with everything tracked in Jira.
